spans.s:
The words beginning with भू 'to become' and denoting action, are called धातु or verbal roots.

Terms: धातु

The source of the agent of the verb भू 'to become' is called अपादान।

Terms: कारक-अपादान

After the root भू 'to be', in construction with a case-inflected word as its उपपद and when used without a preposition, the affix क्यप् is used to denote condition - भाव।

Terms: Irregular

The affix इष्णुच् in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verb भू 'to be' etc.

Terms: छन्दस् इष्णुच्

The affix ङीष् is always used in the छन्दस् (Vedas) in forming the feminine after the word भु।

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीष्

The affix क्विप् comes after the verb भू 'to be' when the word so formed denotes a name or surety.

Terms: क्विप्

भू gets the augment व् (वुक्) before the tense-affixes of the Aorist and the Perfect, when beginning with a vowel.

Terms: Semi-vowel substitution

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), both रु and र् may replace the final of the word भुवस् when used as a महाव्याहृति।

Terms: Final Changes
